title: Moving cartons
passage: A. A worker is pushing a cart loaded with boxes. B. A worker is opening a box on the floor. C. Some boxes are hanging from the ceiling. D. A worker is sitting on an empty cart.
passageZh:
A. 一名工作人員正推著載有紙箱的推車。
B. 一名工作人員正在地板上打開紙箱。
C. 一些紙箱懸掛在天花板上。
D. 一名工作人員坐在空推車上。
